Overview

Kamenica is a city in Gjilan with a population of 12,000. A small town in eastern Kosovo, known for its archaeological site of Ulpiana, the medieval Church of St. Nicholas, and its mining heritage. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
